Mission Local reported that MEDA was in the process of buying the four-story brick building at 2901 16th St., at South Van Ness Avenue, to convert it into 62 units of permanent affordable housing. During rehabilitation, existing tenants would have the option to stay or move out temporarily; the article said MEDA was unsure how rents would be adjusted for tenants who stayed. The purchase depended on city approval of a loan.
